summary: Betterware de Mexico filed a routine Form 6-K, the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US periodic report, covering the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. The submission contains 59 exhibits, largely XBRL tagging of segment revenue by brand and product line—Tupperware kitchen and home, Jafra beauty and personal care, and Betterware household goods—plus balance-sheet and subsequent-event data. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. No special-situation event is present; watch only for ordinary quarterly operating trends and any later strategic announcement.
